    Write-Log ('SENETECH V{0} installe dans {1}' -f $script:DisplayVersion, $destination) 'OK'

    if (-not $Silent) {
        $launch = [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show(
            "SENETECH est maintenant installe sur ce PC.`n`nVoulez-vous ouvrir la version installee maintenant ?",
            'Installation SENETECH terminee',
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::YesNo,
            [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Information)
        if ($launch -eq [System.Windows.MessageBoxResult]::Yes) {
            Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $destination 'SENETECH-Setup.exe') -WorkingDirectory $destination | Out-Null
            try { if ($script:NetworkTimer) { $script:NetworkTimer.Stop() } } catch {}
            try { if ($script:StartupUpdateTimer) { $script:StartupUpdateTimer.Stop() } } catch {}
            $window.Close()
        }
    }
    return $destination
}

function Sync-SenetechInstalledRegistration {
    if (-not $script:IsInstalledMode) { return }
    try {
        Register-SenetechInstalledApp $script:Root
    } catch {
        # L'application reste utilisable meme si Windows refuse une mise a jour de l'entree de desinstallation.
    }
}
